meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能执行一次“接入 Atomic Chat”的配置:检查桌面应用是否就绪,复制并注册连接代码,再跑构建和测试。成功后,项目里的 agent 会多出“列出模型”和“把任务交给本地模型处理”两件事可做。
howto.when: 当你明确要求“把 Atomic Chat 接入项目”或“添加 atomic_chat 工具”时触发。动工前需满足:Atomic Chat 桌面版已开启、本地 API 服务在 1337 端口可用、至少已下载一个模型。

say.text: 接入 Atomic Chat,让 agent 能用本地模型。
say.note: 会先检查环境再动手接线。

say.text: 给项目添加 atomic_chat MCP 工具。
say.note: 会执行完整的接入与验证流程。

say.text: 帮我把项目 agent 配上 Atomic Chat 本地模型。
say.note: 缺少前置条件时它会先提示你。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude runs an Atomic Chat integration: it checks readiness, copies and registers the connection code, then builds and tests. On success, the project agent can list models and delegate tasks to a local model.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Atomic Chat to the project or add the atomic_chat tool. Prerequisites: Atomic Chat desktop is running, its local API is reachable on port 1337, and one model is downloaded.

say_en.text: Add Atomic Chat so the agent can use local models.
say_en.note: It checks the environment first, then wires it.

say_en.text: Add the atomic_chat MCP tool to the project.
say_en.note: Runs the full integration and verification flow.

say_en.text: Set up the project agent with Atomic Chat local models.
say_en.note: It will warn you if prerequisites are missing.
